name: acid arrow
lore:
### Melf’s Vitriolic Shaft (Acid Arrow)

To shape this spell is to invite a sharp, stinging tingle into the fingertips, as if one’s very blood has turned to citrus and lightning. The Weave responds with a curdled resistance; the air around the caster thickens with the acrid stench of vinegar and scorched earth. 

Upon release, the magic manifests as a shimmering bolt of translucent emerald bile. It does not fly with the whistle of a fletched arrow, but with a low, predatory hiss. When it strikes, it does not merely pierce; it *hungers*. The liquid clings to the target, bubbling and churning as it dissolves leather, plate, and bone alike with a persistent, malevolent glow.

**The Legend of its Genesis**
Chronicles attribute this formula to the Elven Prince Melf. During the Siege of the Iron Crags, his company found their mundane arrows glancing harmlessly off the enchanted plate of the Duergar vanguard. Melf, blending alchemical theory with arcane geometry, wove a projectile that didn't need to pierce armor to defeat it—it simply had to unmake it.
